description: The Rust extension (PyO3) that executes validation and serialization; `pydantic` itself only builds schemas from Python classes.
The dict `pydantic` generates from annotations at class creation (`__pydantic_core_schema__`), compiled into a `SchemaValidator` and `SchemaSerializer`.
Validation, serialization and JSON Schema for any type (`list[int]`, a `TypedDict`, a dataclass); costly to build, so create it once.
Parses and validates JSON text in one Rust pass, avoiding intermediate Python objects.
A C library of `Struct` types with fast JSON and MessagePack decoding and type checks; fewer hooks than Pydantic.
Python libraries for classes with optional validators (attrs) and for structuring dicts into them (cattrs).
